cost.cost_scope: New compute only; conservative single-GPU reserved wall includes CPU/I/O. Original U8000 training is reused, not counted as new work.
cost.active_cost_limit: Progress snapshots omit still-running elapsed actions from completed reserved totals.

training_mechanism.gradient_interpretation: Zero output weights make earlier descriptor gradients zero on the first update; later nonzero gradients show learning paths become active. This is implementation behavior, not evidence of useful conditioning.
training_mechanism.training_gate_range_interpretation: Training ranges combine changing parameters and changing frames; they are not fixed-checkpoint frame sensitivity.

coefficient_units: Weights and shifts are fractions; _pp fields multiply by100. Maximum allowed absolute change is10 percentage points per layer, possibly less near a boundary.
boundary_fraction_definition: abs(weight-baseline)>=0.099 and separately >=99% of that layer's allowed amplitude; each denominator is the corresponding recorded frames/updates, not independent observations.
decoder_rms_interpretation: Telemetry is measured immediately before the diagnostic mask and fusion linear, so masked-view telemetry still describes the pre-mask input. The archived LayerNorm-times-five branch does not guarantee an RMS of five: small pre-normalization variance relative to epsilon can yield a smaller RMS. Describe inputs using the saved observed RMS statistics, not the scale factor. Input RMS does not quantify predictive contribution, modality dominance, or a causal gate effect.
neutral_interpretation: Trained-minus-neutral combines encoder and gate adaptation. Neutral is not an equal-update control. Dynamic-minus-constant is the matched conditioning contrast conditional on the shared enabled decoder route.
original_decoder_path_clarification: Original A0-A3 also share the same encoder_decoder architecture through common config inheritance; their adaptation guards freeze decoder parameters. The shared route is conditional mechanism context, not by itself a differential architectural confound. Static-four-logit versus dynamic-MLP parameterization differs. See MECHANISM_AUDIT.md for exact source evidence.
intervention_interpretation: Decoder-zero is an inference-only input intervention on a decoder-route-trained checkpoint; resulting sensitivity is not retrained path-free efficacy or a causal gate estimate.
evidence_limit: Historically exposed mini; two folds/six trained replicas reuse the same four outer logs. Sameprocess AI review is not external independent replication; no iidframe CI/pvalue, causal/SOTA/calibratedsafety/collisionrisk/externalgeneralization claim.
